decoded.documentation: the string mcp.netlify.com occurs zero times in all seven vendor documents archived in this pass (both llms.txt files, the agent-setup overview, the build-with-AI overview, the agent-experience page, the pricing twin and netlify.ai), while netlify-mcp.netlify.app occurs once in the docs llms.txt and three times in the setup guide

finding: A host the vendor documents nowhere, mcp.netlify.com, answers the same keyless MCP initialize with the same 401 and a body whose sha256 equals the documented host's to the digit, measured 2026-10-21 at 06:12:59.542Z. Its discovery documents are host-relative rather than redirects: the protected-resource document (200, 197 bytes) names mcp.netlify.com as the resource and itself as the authorization server, and the authorization-server document (200, 571 bytes) carries issuer https://mcp.netlify.com/ with the documented host's configuration otherwise unchanged. So one service is reachable at two hostnames that advertise two different issuer identities, only one of which any vendor surface names. This probe states what the requests answered; it does not establish which host a client should use.
